tasks.title: Implement Command Help and Documentation
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive command help text and documentation to guide users on using the main enigma command.
tasks.details:
Enhance the command with detailed help text and examples:

1. Update the command description and help text:
```typescript
command
  .name('enigma')
  .description('Optimize Tailwind CSS by consolidating repetitive class patterns')
  .usage('[options]')
  .addHelpText('after', `
Examples:
  $ enigma                                # Basic optimization with auto-discovery
  $ enigma --build-dir dist              # Specify build directory
  $ enigma --output-css styles/enigma.css # Specify output CSS location
  $ enigma --dry-run --verbose           # Preview optimization without changes
  $ enigma --scramble --scramble-speed 100 # Enable scrambling effect
`)
```

2. Add detailed option descriptions:
```typescript
command
  .option('--build-dir <dir>', 'Specify build output directory (auto-discovered if not provided)')
  .option('--output-css <path>', 'Specify output CSS file location (defaults to enigma.css in build dir)')
  .option('--pattern-threshold <number>', 'Minimum occurrences for pattern consolidation (default: 3)')
  .option('--dry-run', 'Simulate optimization without modifying files')
  .option('--verbose', 'Enable detailed logging of the optimization process')
  .option('--scramble', 'Enable scramble integration (requires @tw-enigma/scramble)')
  .option('--scramble-speed <speed>', 'Set scramble animation speed (default: 100)')
  .option('--scramble-debug', 'Enable scramble debug mode')
```

3. Update the main README.md to include documentation for the new command:
```markdown
## Core Command

The main `enigma` command performs the complete CSS pattern optimization workflow:

```bash
# Basic optimization
enigma

# With configuration
enigma --build-dir dist --output-css assets/enigma.css

# With scrambling effect
enigma --scramble --scramble-speed 100

# Dry run mode
enigma --dry-run --verbose
```

This implementation provides clear guidance on how to use the command, making it accessible to new users.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the help output by running `enigma --help` and verifying all options and examples are correctly displayed. Verify the README.md documentation is accurate and comprehensive.
